summary: Established speech-first user-attention delivery with packaged-sound and terminal fallbacks.
intent: Let parallel AI-agent tasks speak concise requests without making paid API access or cloud speech mandatory.

summary: Adopted user-selected cloud TTS providers, models, voices, and user-supplied API keys.
intent: Avoid persistent Codex Voice conversations while preserving explicit provider choice and billing control.

summary: Simplified attention requests to a required message and optional source without a fixed event taxonomy.
intent: Allow agents to describe any concise user action without forcing requests into categories that do not change delivery behavior.

summary: Added the AttentionRequest domain contract and normalized message validation with a 120-character limit.
intent: Reject empty or overly long speech requests before they reach delivery providers.

summary: Added typed delivery modes and discriminated success or failure attempt results.
intent: Preserve which delivery path and handler ran while requiring a diagnostic reason for failures.

summary: Separated speech provider and local audio player capability interfaces.
intent: Keep cloud synthesis concerns independent from operating-system audio playback and defer unverified audio transport contracts.

summary: Added user-owned speech selection and provider API-key environment metadata.
intent: Keep provider, model, voice, style, and credential lookup ownership separate from agent attention requests.

summary: Added provider capability metadata and diagnostic speech-selection validation results.
intent: Expose network, billing, output, style, model, and voice constraints before attempting paid cloud synthesis.

summary: Added the ordered speech, packaged-sound, and terminal delivery policy.
intent: Stop after the first successful delivery while preventing automatic calls to unselected cloud providers.

summary: Added delivery queue and lease coordination boundaries.
intent: Allow speech delivery to be serialized across processes without coupling delivery policy to a specific lock implementation.

summary: Added a fakeable process execution boundary with normalized results.
intent: Keep operating-system command execution out of delivery and player logic while preserving safe argument arrays and deterministic tests.

summary: Narrowed v0.1 cloud speech support to the OpenAI Speech API.
intent: Reduce initial implementation and validation scope while preserving a provider-neutral boundary for future expansion.

summary: Fixed the v0.1 speech model and built-in voice catalogs with ordered defaults.
intent: Let users override model and voice from validated settings while providing deterministic defaults when settings are absent.

summary: Added user-selectable buffered and streaming speech playback to the v0.1 scope.
intent: Keep buffered playback as the reliable default while adding a streaming learning path and latency-sensitive option without allowing agent overrides or duplicate paid retries.

summary: Added typed buffered and streaming playback selection with a buffered default.
intent: Let users choose the speech playback strategy while keeping a deterministic default and validating external configuration before use.

summary: Added a discriminated speech-audio contract for buffered WAV and streaming PCM output.
intent: Keep complete audio bytes and incremental PCM chunks type-safe while allowing providers and players to remain independently testable.

summary: Added an explicit speech synthesis success or failure result contract.
intent: Represent expected provider failures without maintaining a closed taxonomy of remote API error categories.

summary: Separated non-secret speech settings from API credential storage.
intent: Keep configurable speech preferences in a user-level JSON file while avoiding ineffective encrypted-file key management and deferring OS vault support until it can be validated per platform.

summary: Added the user-recorded packaged notification MP3 asset.
intent: Prepare a verified offline fallback sound while preserving the original recording without conversion.

summary: Added module-relative resolution of the packaged notification asset.
intent: Resolve the same bundled MP3 from TypeScript and compiled JavaScript independently of the caller working directory.

summary: Prioritize file playback and real-agent buffered TTS before streaming
intent: Validate useful agent speech end to end before adding PCM streaming complexity

summary: Revise planned credential onboarding to CLI hidden input and OS storage with separate development configuration; implementation remains pending.
intent: Let people configure Doorbell through its CLI while keeping development settings and credentials separate from installed user state.

summary: Adopt English guidance, optional custom tone, nova defaults, and independent configuration commands.
intent: Implement the revised product direction after the learning phase.

summary: Expanded supported speech providers to OpenAI and Gemini with explicit selection and shared optional free-text tone.
intent: Support the requested second cloud TTS provider while preserving user-owned settings.

summary: Replace saved tone with per-call provider-specific directions, voice and speed; publish official TTS manuals for agents.
intent: Let each notification reflect the calling agent current personality without maintaining a separate Doorbell tone profile.

summary: Document implemented coordination, diagnostics, hooks, streaming, and local plugin boundaries.
intent: Reflect the completed implementation phase and verified mode limits.

summary: Describe the supported Gemini TTS models and live voice picker.
intent: Document the available Gemini configuration workflow.

summary: Add the original piano cue before spoken notifications.
intent: Make speech notifications less sudden across providers.
